report:
Fresh source review of crates.sage_ir.symbols.local_identity after start with the captured CI coordinator instructions. Inspected the current complete claim, all 15 ordinary implementation associations across 13 files, and the complete five-test set. Requirements: identity fields identify a definition; CST, placement and separately computed semantic facts are not identity; detail-only changes preserve identities; consumers of unchanged sibling facts remain reusable; actual identity changes are distinguishable.

Implementation: fns.rs, consts.rs and type_aliases.rs keep name, scope and optional owner outside tracked detail; their CST and absolute spans are tracked. structs.rs, enums.rs, traits.rs and statics.rs use name/scope identity and tracked CST/span. impls.rs and macro_invocations.rs retain scope identity and tracked CST/span. uses.rs retains scope while imports, attributes and span are tracked. macro_defs.rs keeps name/scope identity separate from attributes, body tokens and span. mods.rs keeps name, edition and parent in identity, with body source, attributes and span tracked. In enums.rs the variant keeps name/parent identity and tracked copied variant CST, tuple shape and span; its constructor has variant/name identity. enum_variants constructs those values from the owning enum, retaining the proper parent even when field detail changes. Signatures, fields, items and bodies are symbol-keyed tracked computations rather than fields in the identity. associated.rs selects a kind/name/occurrence key within each owner and lowers its own copied CST and placement into a symbol containing that owner. Therefore inserting or reordering other named siblings does not change the selected item's identity key. The current function parser separately supplies name/scope and CST/span, and test setup updates the same source input and tracked root context.

Ordinary test assessment: detail_edits_preserve_local_symbol_query_keys exercises twelve represented item kinds (function body, struct and enum field type, trait member signature, impl member body, alias value, const and static initializers, module attributes, use path, macro definition tokens, invocation arguments). It rejects parse-error placeholders, checks a warm query log, then asserts no identity observer execution after the detail edit. enum_detail_edits_preserve_variant_query_keys changes tuple-variant field type, confirms represented fields and checks reuse of observed variant and constructor identities. moving_associated_items_preserves_symbol_query_keys covers trait/impl functions, types and constants under both insertion and reordering; it asserts owner equality and observer reuse in forward and reverse edits. Those cases include changed positions and unchanged sibling identities. local_function_identity_changes_are_distinguishable has a cold execution control, verifies the renamed function's actual name and fresh observer execution, then checks same-name functions in distinct scopes have unequal scopes and identities. This guards against collapsing genuine identity differences. Captured ObservedSymbol and observe_symbol_identity helpers use the actual symbol as an interned observer key; captured database code logs WillExecute and drains/reset logs, so the assertions distinguish actual recomputation from warm reuse. Test expectations are visible at their call sites.

TODO assessment: symbols_local_identity explicitly defers an exhaustive per-kind sibling insertion/reordering and signature/member/body reuse matrix. That remains a legitimate, visible test gap rather than a passing behavioral test. Its completion requires extending current same-database edit fixtures with direct consumers of each semantic fact and checking that unchanged sibling consumers do not execute. Existing identity observers establish the concrete detail and associated-movement cases; they do not establish every semantic consumer's reuse for every local kind. No N/A entries or implementation TODOs are being inferred. All requirements are either covered by current source/ordinary test evidence or explicitly accounted for by this retained test deferral.

No source edits were made during this refresh. Executed review start and dependency reads; no behavior tests or workspace builds were run by this reviewer in this refresh, per the captured instruction that root runs central suites. The assessment does not rely on previous approvals or previous test results. No current behavioral violation was identified in the reviewed identity boundary, and no edits are requested.
